selected_sources.title: NASA POLAR Stereo Dataset
selected_sources.license_basis: NASA Science Data Portal policy: NASA-led mission data are CC0 unless the file carries a restrictive notice or license.
selected_sources.attribution: Cite the POLAR Stereo Dataset and NASA Ames Intelligent Robotics Group.
limitations: Physical lunar analog, not lunar flight imagery.
Bedrock is not an annotated POLAR class.

selected_sources.title: POLAR-Sim segmentation labels and terrain assets
selected_sources.license_basis: Dryad data release policy; dataset is published on Dryad and reports 12 terrain experiments.
selected_sources.attribution: Cite Chen et al. (2025), POLAR-Sim, DOI 10.5061/dryad.ksn02v7hf.
limitations: Existing masks do not contain target crater or bedrock labels; crater masks require new geometry-supported annotation.

selected_sources.title: Mars-Bench MSL terrain segmentation mirror
selected_sources.license_basis: Dataset card declares CC-BY-4.0 and lists bedrock, gravel/sand/soil, rock, shadow, sky/mountains, and track.
selected_sources.attribution: Credit the dataset uploader and cite the original Mars-Bench/AI4Mars sources as documented with the acquired version.
limitations: Mars imagery is cross-domain training data only; it must not enter lunar/analog validation or test splits.
Verify attribution and upstream data terms against the exact downloaded revision before ingestion.

selected_sources.title: BASEPROD labeled RGB/mask subset
selected_sources.license_basis: Pinned Zenodo API record explicitly declares cc-by-4.0; acquired members verified against ZIP CRC and retained SHA-256.
selected_sources.attribution: Castilla Arquillo, Perez del Pulgar Mancebo, Gerdes, Garcia-Cerezo and Martinez Petersen. Fusion of Color, Depth, and Thermal Modalities for Rover Navigation in Unstructured Environments. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20289198. Also cite Gerdes et al. (2024), DOI 10.1038/s41597-024-03881-1. Canonical remapping is a modification.
limitations: Mars analogue, not lunar flight imagery.
Only 48 uniformly sampled pairs; all Bardenas views confined to test.
Only source bedrock, sandy and rock mapped; remaining classes ignored.

selected_sources.title: NASA Apollo 15 Hadley Rille outcrop photographs
selected_sources.license_basis: NASA-led mission data follow NASA Science Data Portal CC0 policy absent a restrictive notice. The archive explicitly asserts no copyright in NASA photographs and requests NASA and scanning credits; reviewed files show landscape only. Captions are separately copyrighted and are not redistributed.
selected_sources.attribution: NASA Apollo 15 photographs AS15-89-12115 and AS15-89-12157; scans by Kipp Teague. Conservative pixel annotations added by Codex on behalf of Jay; image hashes and normalized polygon coordinates retained.
limitations: Two 500-mm telephoto frames from one Hadley Rille scene; not rover-scale representative sampling.
Only conservative illuminated outcrop/regolith patches annotated; all other pixels ignored.
Entire related scene confined to validation; no optimization on these frames.

selected_sources.title: NASA POLAR Traverse exact-frame crater annotations
selected_sources.source_version: 2023 release; View1 Traverse1 positions 0,2,4,6,8,10 m, left camera, 25ms
selected_sources.license_basis: NASA-led scientific data policy; source-page and acquired image inspection found no restrictive notice. Original photographs only; paper figures retained as internal review aids.
selected_sources.attribution: Hansen, Wong and Fong, NASA Ames, POLAR Traverse Dataset (2023). Partial annotations by Codex on behalf of Jay; source member CRC and SHA-256, polygons and derived crop lineage retained.
limitations: Six views of one constructed scene; all views and derivatives confined to training.
Only reviewed 25ms frames annotated; no propagation to other exposures.
Uncertain, underexposed and saturated wall/soil pixels ignored.

evaluation_additions.scope: Bounded prototype evaluation only; additions do not establish broad lunar bedrock accuracy.

rejected_candidates.reason: The repository states MIT while also limiting commercial use to author contact; its linked LICENSE returns 404. It also lacks target bedrock and shadow categories and reports 108 GB, above the current laptop data budget.
NASA catalog says license not specified while the Zenodo record reports Copyright 2022 IEEE; do not ingest until the rights holder publishes an unambiguous grant.
